<!-- Generated by internal/tools/docgen (task docs-gen). Edit the code, not this file. -->

A transform takes entities of its **input** type and writes what it
finds, mostly entities of its **output** type linked to the input. How
to run one is in [transforms](/guide/transforms/). A secret is the name
of a key you keep on the [Secrets](/guide/secrets/) page, never the
value itself.

## Secrets

| Secret | Required by | Optional for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ABUSEIPDB_API_KEY` | `ip_to_abuseipdb` |  |
| `C99_API_KEY` |  | `website_to_subdomains` |
| `CENSYS_API_TOKEN` | `ip_to_censys` |  |
| `CENSYS_ORG_ID` |  | `ip_to_censys` |
| `DEHASHED_API_KEY` | `domain_to_dehashed`, `email_to_dehashed`, `ip_to_dehashed`, `individual_to_dehashed`, `phone_to_dehashed`, `username_to_dehashed` |  |
| `ETHERSCAN_API_KEY` | `cryptowallet_to_nfts`, `cryptowallet_to_transactions` |  |

| `N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN` |  | `n8n_connector` |

| `WHOXY_API_KEY` | `domain_to_history`, `email_to_domains`, `individual_to_domains`, `org_to_domains` |  |

## ASN

### asn_to_cidrs

List the IP ranges an autonomous system announces (RIPEstat).

Takes `asn`, finds `cidr`.

## Automation

### n8n_connector

Send the selected entities to an n8n webhook, for workflows run outside gosint.

Takes any entity, finds `phrase`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `webhook_url` (required) | url |  | The n8n webhook URL to send data to. |
| `N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN` | secret |  | The secret holding the token n8n checks on the webhook, sent as a Bearer Authorization header. Leave it unset for a webhook without auth. |
| `extra_payload` | string |  | A JSON object merged into the payload. |

## CIDR

### cidr_to_ips

List the addresses of an IP range, up to a limit.

Takes `cidr`, finds `ip`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | number | `256` | Most addresses to add per range, at most 65536 |

## Crypto wallet

### cryptowallet_to_nfts

List the NFT transfers of a wallet (Etherscan).

Takes `cryptowallet`, finds `cryptonft`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ETHERSCAN_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The Etherscan API key. |
| `ETHERSCAN_API_URL` | url | `https://api.etherscan.io/v2/api` | The Etherscan API URL. |

### cryptowallet_to_transactions

List the first 100 Ethereum transactions of a wallet (Etherscan).

Takes `cryptowallet`, finds `cryptowallettransaction`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ETHERSCAN_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The Etherscan API key. |
| `ETHERSCAN_API_URL` | url | `https://api.etherscan.io/v2/api` | The Etherscan API URL. |

## Domain

### domain_to_asn

Find the autonomous systems hosting a domain's addresses (RIPEstat).

Takes `domain`, finds `asn`.

### domain_to_dehashed

Find the breach records of a domain, every account under it in DeHashed and what leaked with it: the password or its hash, names, emails, usernames, phones, IPs.

Takes `domain`, finds `breach`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DEHASHED_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | Your DeHashed API key, from dehashed.com/api. |
| `max_results` | number | `100` | Most records to read per entity, at most 10000 |

### domain_to_dns

Read a domain's DNS records: addresses, CNAME, MX and NS hosts as domains, and TXT records.

Takes `domain`, finds `ip`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ipv6` | select | `true` | Also resolve AAAA (IPv6) records One of `true`, `false`. |

### domain_to_history

Read the WHOIS history of a domain and the contacts it names (Whoxy).

Takes `domain`, finds `domain`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `WHOXY_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The Whoxy API key. |

### domain_to_hunter

List the email addresses Hunter.io found on a domain, each under the person it names when known.

Takes `domain`, finds `email`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `HUNTER_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The Hunter.io API key. |
| `max_results` | number | `100` | How many addresses to read. |

### domain_to_ip

Resolve a domain to its IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

Takes `domain`, finds `ip`.

### domain_to_root_domain

Find the registrable root domain of a subdomain.

Takes `domain`, finds `domain`.

### domain_to_securitytrails

List a domain's subdomains and the addresses its A records point to, from SecurityTrails.

Takes `domain`, finds `domain`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SECURITYTRAILS_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The SecurityTrails API key. |
| `max_results` | number | `200` | How many subdomains to draw. |

### domain_to_subdomains

Find subdomains of a domain with subfinder's passive sources, or else in certificate transparency logs (crt.sh).

Takes `domain`, finds `domain`.

### domain_to_tls

Read the TLS certificate a domain serves over https.

Takes `domain`, finds `sslcertificate`.

### domain_to_urlscan

List the pages urlscan.io scanned under the domain, each with the address it was served from.

Takes `domain`, finds `website`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `URLSCAN_API_KEY` | secret |  | An urlscan.io API key, for more results and private scans. |
| `max_results` | number | `100` | How many scans to read. |

### domain_to_virustotal

Read how many engines call a domain malicious on VirusTotal (any red) and the addresses it resolved to.

Takes `domain`, finds `ip`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The VirusTotal API key. |

### domain_to_website

Fetch the website a domain serves, with its title, description, status, server and redirects.

Takes `domain`, finds `website`.

### domain_to_whois

Read the current WHOIS record of a domain: registrar, dates, registrant.

Takes `domain`, finds `whois`.

### domain_to_whois_history

Read the WHOIS history records of a domain (WhoisXML API, uses purchase credits).

Takes `domain`, finds `whois`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `WHOISXML_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The WhoisXML API key for WHOIS history lookups. |

## Email

### email_to_breaches

Find the data breaches an email address appears in (Have I Been Pwned).

Takes `email`, finds `breach`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `HIBP_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The HIBP API key to use for breaches lookup. |
| `HIBP_API_URL` | url | `https://haveibeenpwned.com/api/v3/breachedaccount/` | The HIBP API URL to use for breaches lookup. |

### email_to_dehashed

Find the breach records of an email address in DeHashed and what leaked with it: the password or its hash, names, emails, usernames, phones, IPs.

Takes `email`, finds `breach`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DEHASHED_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | Your DeHashed API key, from dehashed.com/api. |
| `max_results` | number | `100` | Most records to read per entity, at most 10000 |

### email_to_domain

Extract the domain of an email address.

Takes `email`, finds `domain`.

### email_to_domains

Find the domains registered with an email address (Whoxy reverse WHOIS).

Takes `email`, finds `domain`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `WHOXY_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The Whoxy API key. |

### email_to_gravatar

Find the Gravatar avatar and public profile of an email address.

Takes `email`, finds `gravatar`.

### email_to_infostealers

Find computers infected by an infostealer that held a login with this email address, with the stealer and what the free API shows (HudsonRock).

Takes `email`, finds `device`.

### email_to_username

Extract the username part of an email address.

Takes `email`, finds `username`.

## Filter

### domain_alive

Narrows: keep only the domains that resolve, or that serve a website, and flag the dead ones red and the ones not answering 200 yellow.

Takes `domain`, finds `domain`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `check` | select | `dns` | dns keeps what resolves to an address, http keeps what answers over https or http One of `dns`, `http`. |
| `with_subdomains` | bool | `false` | Also check every subdomain found under the selected ones, all the way down |

### domain_root_only

Narrows: keep only the registrable root domains (example.com, not www.example.com), or only the subdomains.

Takes `domain`, finds `domain`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | select | `root` | root keeps the registrable domains, sub keeps the subdomains One of `root`, `sub`. |

### ip_drop_cdn

Narrows: drop the IP addresses that belong to a CDN or cloud front (Cloudflare, Fastly, AWS, Google Cloud), so the next step probes only the hosts themselves.

Takes `ip`, finds `ip`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `providers` | string | `cloudflare,fastly,aws,gcp` | Which providers count, comma-separated: cloudflare, fastly, aws, gcp |
| `mode` | select | `drop` | drop passes on what is NOT matched, keep passes on only what is One of `drop`, `keep`. |

### ip_public_only

Narrows: drop private, loopback, link-local and reserved addresses, keep the ones routable on the internet. A lab with worker.allow_private_targets on does not want this step.

Takes `ip`, finds `ip`.

## Graph

### fields_to_entities

Draw what this entity's fields name as entities of their own: a person's phones, emails, addresses, bank accounts and relatives, an organization's site, contacts and executives, a device's addresses, a certificate's domains, a card's holder. Nothing is looked up.

Takes any entity, finds what the fields name.

### files_to_entities

Draw what the entity's attached files say about themselves: the place a photo was taken, the person who wrote a document, the camera it was shot with. Nothing is looked up.

Takes any entity, finds what the fields name.

## IP

### ip_to_abuseipdb

Read an address's abuse confidence and reports from AbuseIPDB, red from 75 up.

Takes `ip`, finds `ip`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ABUSEIPDB_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The AbuseIPDB API key. |
| `max_age_days` | number | `90` | How far back the reports count. |

### ip_to_asn

Find the autonomous system announcing an IP address (RIPEstat).

Takes `ip`, finds `asn`.

### ip_to_censys

List the services Censys saw on an address as ports with their software, with its location, network, names and the CVEs Censys matches.

Takes `ip`, finds `port`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CENSYS_API_TOKEN` (required) | secret |  | A Censys Platform personal access token. |
| `CENSYS_ORG_ID` | secret |  | The Censys organization to bill, the free credits of the token's account without it. |

### ip_to_dehashed

Find the breach records of an IP address in DeHashed and what leaked with it: the password or its hash, names, emails, usernames, phones, IPs.

Takes `ip`, finds `breach`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DEHASHED_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | Your DeHashed API key, from dehashed.com/api. |
| `max_results` | number | `100` | Most records to read per entity, at most 10000 |

### ip_to_domain

Find domains for an IP address by reverse DNS, or else by certificate transparency.

Takes `ip`, finds `domain`.

### ip_to_fraudscore

Score how likely an IP address is used for fraud, and flag proxies and VPNs (Scamalytics).

Takes `ip`, finds `riskprofile`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SCAMLYTICS_USERNAME` (required) | secret |  | The Scamalytics username. |
| `SCAMLYTICS_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The Scamalytics API key. |
| `SCAMLYTICS_API_HOST` | string | `api12` | The Scamalytics API host prefix of your account, such as api12. |

### ip_to_greynoise

Ask GreyNoise whether an address scans the internet (noise) or is a known service (riot), malicious ones red.

Takes `ip`, finds `ip`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GREYNOISE_API_KEY` | secret |  | A GreyNoise API key, for a larger quota. The community API answers without one. |

### ip_to_infos

Geolocate an IP address and name its ISP (ip-api.com).

Takes `ip`, finds `ip`.

### ip_to_ports

List open TCP ports of an IP address, from Shodan InternetDB without contacting the target, or by scanning it with nmap on the server.

Takes `ip`, finds `port`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | select | `passive` | Where the ports come from One of `passive`, `active`. |
| `top_ports` | number | `100` | Active scan only: how many of the most common ports to try, at most 1000 |

### ip_to_shodan

List the services Shodan saw on an address as ports with their banners, with its location, network, names and the CVEs Shodan matches.

Takes `ip`, finds `port`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SHODAN_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The Shodan API key. |

### ip_to_virustotal

Read how many engines call an address malicious on VirusTotal, any red.

Takes `ip`, finds `ip`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | The VirusTotal API key. |

## Security

### cve_to_details

Fill a CVE from the NVD (page, description, CVSS, severity, CWE, published, references, CISA KEV) and FIRST (EPSS score and percentile).

Takes `cve`, finds `cve`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NVD_API_KEY` | secret |  | Optional, raises the NVD's rate limit from 5 to 50 requests in 30 seconds. |

### cve_to_vulnerability

Make a vulnerability of a CVE, with its severity, CVSS, CWE, description and references, open and linked to the CVE.

Takes `cve`, finds `vulnerability`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `affected` | string |  | What it affects, a URL, a host or a component and version. Empty leaves it to fill in. |

### finding_to_vulnerability

Confirm a finding: draw the vulnerability it is, with its severity, place, description and CVE, and mark the finding confirmed.

Takes `finding`, finds `vulnerability`.

### vulnerability_to_details

Fill a vulnerability's empty fields from the NVD record of its CVE (severity, CVSS, CWE, description, references) and link the CVE.

Takes `vulnerability`, finds `cve`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NVD_API_KEY` | secret |  | Optional, raises the NVD's rate limit from 5 to 50 requests in 30 seconds. |

## Social

### username_to_accounts

Find the sites a username has a profile on, by asking each one (GitHub, YouTube, Steam and more).

Takes `username`, finds `socialaccount`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sites` | string |  | Only these sites, comma-separated names such as GitHub, YouTube. Empty asks every site. |

### username_to_dehashed

Find the breach records of a username in DeHashed and what leaked with it: the password or its hash, names, emails, usernames, phones, IPs.

Takes `username`, finds `breach`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DEHASHED_API_KEY` (required) | secret |  | Your DeHashed API key, from dehashed.com/api. |
| `max_results` | number | `100` | Most records to read per entity, at most 10000 |

### username_to_infostealers

Find computers infected by an infostealer that held a login with this username, with the stealer and what the free API shows (HudsonRock).

Takes `username`, finds `device`.

## Website

### tech_detect

Detect the technologies a website runs, from its headers and HTML.

Takes `website`, finds `technology`.

### website_to_crawler

Crawl a website for the email addresses and international phone numbers it publishes.

Takes `website`, finds `email`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_pages` | number | `25` | Most pages of the site to read, at most 2000 |
| `delay_ms` | number | `1000` | Milliseconds to wait between two requests to the site, 0 for none, at most 60000 |

### website_to_domain

Extract the domain of a website, without www.

Takes `website`, finds `domain`.

### website_to_links

Crawl a website and link it to the sites its pages link to.

Takes `website`, finds `website`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_pages` | number | `25` | Most pages of the site to read, at most 2000 |
| `delay_ms` | number | `1000` | Milliseconds to wait between two requests to the site, 0 for none, at most 60000 |

### website_to_subdomains

Find the subdomains of a website, from subfinder and crt.sh, or from c99.nl with its address and Cloudflare flag.

Takes `website`, finds `website`.

| Parameter | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | select | `free` | Where the subdomains come from One of `free`, `c99`. |
| `C99_API_KEY` | secret |  | Your C99.nl API key, for the c99 source only. |

### website_to_text

Extract the visible text of a website.

Takes `website`, finds `phrase`.

### website_to_webtrackers

Find the analytics and advertising IDs a website embeds (Google, Meta, Hotjar, Yandex).

Takes `website`, finds `webtracker`.
